Feature enable and disable helpers, including cleaned-up and one-off activation.

# Purpose
This C file defines helper functions for managing feature activation state in `fd_features_t`. It provides routines to enable all features, disable all features, and enable only features that are cleaned up for a given `fd_cluster_version_t`. Each function iterates over the feature list with `fd_feature_iter_init`, `fd_feature_iter_done`, and `fd_feature_iter_next`, then updates the feature state with `fd_features_set`.

The file also defines [`fd_features_enable_one_offs`](<#fd_features_enable_one_offs>), which enables selected features by matching Base58-encoded public keys against feature IDs. It decodes each key with `fd_base58_decode_32`, compares it with each `fd_feature_id_t`, and sets the matching feature to the given `slot`. This file is part of the feature configuration logic and does not define a public executable entry point.
